pages.text: Affinity maturation, as in a germinal centre: each round of selection keeps the clones that bind best, so the affinity grows as (1 + s)^n. But the same culling narrows the line: diversity falls as e^(-n.s/3). Bind tightly enough, and keep enough variety.
$(thing)Set$(): Rounds, Stringency.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Assay scatter: the affinity varies by +/- 2%.d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The line collapses to one clone.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A varied line grows faster.
